reply: [{"query": "根据这份E6(R3) GCP指南，申办者在获知SUSAR后应在多少天内完成向监管机构的加急报告？", "query_en": "According to this E6(R3) GCP guidance, within how many days after becoming aware of a SUSAR must the sponsor submit the expedited report to the regulatory authority?", "topic": "SUSAR报告时限（天数）", "absence_terms": ["days", "expedited report", "reporting timeline"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 18, "text": "(c) All suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions (SUSARs) in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements"}, "rationale": "文档规定investigator应向IRB报告SUSAR，但仅称须“依据适用监管要求”，并未给出具体报告天数或时限，属于该体裁文件通常会明确却在此未覆盖之事。"}, {"query": "根据这份指南，申办者是否须为受试者在临床试验期间受到的伤害提供保险或赔偿保障？", "query_en": "Does this guidance require the sponsor to provide insurance or compensation coverage for trial participants who are injured during the clinical trial?", "topic": "受试者伤害保险/赔偿要求", "absence_terms": ["insurance", "indemnify", "compensation for injury"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 17, "text": "1.2.8 If the trial participants are compensated for their participation in the trial, the IRB/IEC should review both the amount and method of payment to participants to assure that neither presents problems of coercion or undue influence on the trial participants."}, "rationale": "该条款仅涉及IRB/IEC对参与报酬金额和方式的审查，并未涉及试验伤害保险或赔偿保障的具体要求，属于GCP类文件通常会规定但此处未覆盖的事项。"}]
